agent_notes: Government-directory membership is established: the exact institution name appears with Sehore, Madhya Pradesh in all five supplied NIRF 2025 pages.

The official identity, campus, and district are verified from mguindia.com, mguindia.com/about-us, and mguindia.com/contact. The Bhopal address on the official site is a city office; the university campus is at Bilkisganj, Sehore.

The official catalogue is partial. mguindia.com/sitemap.xml lists additional programme families whose faculty or course pages returned HTTP 500, including agriculture, journalism, library diploma, hotel-management postgraduate pages, computer-science bachelor, fashion-designing, interior-design, arts, and philosophy URLs. Those inaccessible pages were not imported.
The linked one-page official course PDF is narrower than the sitemap and does not cover all listed faculty/course families; this is why the record remains manual_review.
The official pharmacy faculty page contains an ambiguous 'SIF' entry; it was not imported as a programme.

The managed proxy produced the exact 'self signed certificate in certificate chain' error for initial NIRF/search/mguindia requests. curl --insecure was used only for public GETs after confirming the expected official/search hostnames. The official course PDF CDN succeeded with normal TLS.
mgu.edu.in and mgu.ac.in were rejected as similarly named unrelated universities.
Career mappings were checked against assets/data/career_path.db with read-only sqlite3 queries; no database changes were made.
